features.title: Supabase reader: tables and RLS policies from SQL migrations

acceptance.check: RLS state and policies come from executing the migrations in a sandboxed in-memory Postgres with Supabase stand-ins; a statement that fails marks the tables it touches unknown.
A migration with an infinite loop or huge memory use is stopped by the time and memory limits and all tables become unknown.
The sandbox process starts with an empty environment, so no secret env vars are reachable from the migrations.
When the migrations produce more than 5,000 tables or more than 5,000 policies, processing stops and the result is marked unknown.
Postgres error messages in errors[] are cut to 200 characters and secrets in them are masked (first 4 chars + ***).
